description: This file defines a dialog class for recording audio within an Android app, managing permissions, service binding, and UI updates during recording.

classes.name: RecordAudioDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for recording audio, handling permissions, service connection, and UI updates during recording.

methods.name: createBinding
methods.description: Creates and inflates the dialog's view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the dialog UI, sets button actions, and starts recording.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Requests microphone permission and manages dialog visibility.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unbinds the recorder service and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startRecording
methods.description: Starts the recording process and updates UI with recording time.

methods.name: stopRecording
methods.description: Stops recording, unbinds service, and returns the recorded attachment.

methods.name: bindRecorderService
methods.description: Binds the recorder service to start recording.

methods.name: onPermissionGranted
methods.description: Handles actions after microphone permission is granted.

methods.name: requestMicrophonePermission
methods.description: Requests microphone permission from the user.
